annotations.text:
The record itself is not here.

It is a working prototype you open and drive, at its own link, because a canvas artboard is selected rather than operated. Keeping a second copy of the record here would only drift from it.

This canvas holds the two things that are documents rather than screens: where the seam falls, and the options still open.

Options B and D are closed. Sharing is a mark with no count, and the exposure sentence belongs to the sharing page rather than the foot of the record.

What is left is A against C: the two marks split across the edges, or sharing moved to a bottom toolbar.
